# Bundled dependencies

- qrcode-generator 2.0.4, downloaded from npm on 2026-10-20. Bundled file: `qrcode.js` from the package's `dist/qrcode.js`. MIT license notice is retained in the bundled source. Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Fraunces variable Latin wght font, @fontsource-variable/fraunces 5.3.0. SIL Open Font License 1.1. Served locally from `assets/fonts`.
- Nunito Sans variable Latin wght font, @fontsource-variable/nunito-sans 5.3.0. SIL Open Font License 1.1. Served locally from `assets/fonts`.

There are no runtime CDN or font-service requests, analytics, advertising, login, or backend services. The only outbound navigation is the explicitly labeled Future Ready link.
